identity.title: The comet-like composition of a protoplanetary disk as revealed by complex cyanides

paper_type_evidence.quote: Here we report the detection of CH$_3$CN (and HCN and HC$_3$N) in the protoplanetary disk around the young star MWC 480.

evidence.quote: in the Taurus star forming region at a distance of 140 pc

question.value: Do complex organic molecules (cyanides) exist in a protoplanetary disk with comet-like abundance ratios?

evidence.quote: It has been hitherto unclear whether the same holds for more complex organic molecules outside of the Solar Nebula
centered on 258.983, 245.622 and 257.498 GHz, respectively.

frequencies_and_spectral_setup.value: 14 SPWs, 61.04 kHz resolution; H13CN in SPW1, HC3N in SPW9, CH3CN in SPW5, each 60-120 MHz wide

evidence.quote: The correlator was configured to observe 14 spectral windows (SPWs) with resolution $\delta\nu$= 61.04 kHz.
Observations were carried out on 2014 June 15, with 33 antennas and baselines of 18–650 m (15–555 k$\lambda$).
The angular resolution is $0."4-0".6$, corresponding to 50–70 AU
The resulting rms noise in 1 km/s bins was $\sim$2.3 mJy per beam.
The total on source integration time was 22 minutes.
Observations were carried out on 2014 June 15

what.value: Disk density structure parameters of MWC 480 (from dust continuum fits)

evidence.quote: We adopt a previously developed disk density structure of MWC 480(cite: Guilloteau11).

what.value: Typical comet CH3CN and HC3N abundance relative to HCN (10%)

evidence.quote: A typical comet contains 10% of CH$_3$CN and HC$_3$N with respect to HCN(cite: Mumma11).

pipeline_or_manual.value: Calibrated by ALMA/NAASC staff with standard procedures

evidence.quote: The visibility data were calibrated by ALMA/ NAASC staff following standard procedures.
Each SPW was further self-calibrated in phase and amplitude in CASA 4.2.2.
J0510+1800 was itself calibrated to an absolute flux of 1.50\[0.08\] Jy on 2014 June 29
Each SPW was further self-calibrated in phase and amplitude in CASA 4.2.2.
using the Briggs weighting scheme, with Brigg’s robustness parameter set to 1–2
For the weak CH$_3$CN lines, a taper of 1$''$ was applied to the visibilties

masking.value: Manual CLEAN mask from H13CN emission, applied to HC3N and CH3CN

evidence.quote: A CLEAN deconvolution was performed with a mask produced manually based on the H$^{13}$CN emission
The data cubes were subsequently continuum subtracted using channels identified as free of spectral line emission.
the synthesized beam is $0.''65 \times 0.''39$ (PA=-7)
rms noise 0.3 mJy beam$^{-1}$

what.value: Disk density structure and stellar mass, inclination, turbulence

evidence.quote: We adopted a disk inclination of 37$^{\circ}$, disk turbulence of 0.05 km/s and a Keplerian velocity field with a stellar mass of 1.8 M$_\odot$(cite: Guilloteau11).

what.value: Fitting approach via visibility chi2 and power-law abundance prescription

evidence.quote: and $\alpha$ is a power law index$^{36}$.

Step size of the abundance grid

method.value: Self-calibrate, Briggs-weighted cubes, continuum subtract, CLEAN with H13CN mask

evidence.quote: The self-calibrated phase and gain SPW-specific solutions were applied to create individual SPW line data cubes

method.value: immoments with 1 sigma clip; spectra with CLEAN masks vs Keplerian masks

evidence.quote: Integrated emission maps were produced using the $immoments$ task in CASA, adding emission $>$1$\sigma$ from each channel.

validation.value: Lower clipping levels do not change result at 10%

evidence.quote: Lower clipping levels do not change the result at the 10% level.

analysis_steps.goal: Fit abundance profiles in visibility space

method.value: Grid of power-law abundance models, LIME radiative transfer, chi2 minimization on visibilities

evidence.quote: The best-fit models are obtained by minimizing $\chi^2$, the weighted difference between the real and imaginary part of the complex visibility

key_parameters.value: x_100AU 1e-14 to 1e-10; alpha ranges 0-1 (H13CN), 1-2 (HC3N), 0-2 (CH3CN); Rout 100 AU

evidence.quote: covers $x_{\rm 100AU}$ from $10^{-14}-10^{-10}$ with respect to $n_{\rm H}$

evidence.quote: For CH$_3$CN, we assumed LTE

fitting.value: chi2 minimization over grid; 3 sigma range

evidence.quote: the 3$\sigma$ abundance range is in \[\].

validation.value: Tested vertical freeze-out layer and LTE vs non-LTE (within 20%)

evidence.quote: found a good agreement (within 20%) between LTE and non-LTE models

analysis_steps.goal: Compare to comets, and ice-to-gas chemistry modelling

method.value: Abundance ratios relative to HCN at 30 and 100 AU; gas-phase and grain-surface disk chemistry models for 1 Myr with varying turbulence

evidence.quote: We ran a number of complete disk chemistry models for 1Myr
self-calibrated in phase and amplitude in CASA 4.2.2
We use the three-dimensional Monte Carlo code LIME$^{39}$ to calculate the radiative transfer and molecular excitation.
The 257 GHz continuum flux density was determined to be 331$\pm$33 mJy

results_numeric.quantity: CH3CN/HCN ratio at 30 and 100 AU (best fit)

evidence.quote: the best-fit HC$_3$N and CH$_3$CN abundances with respect to HCN are 0.4 and 0.05 at 30 AU, and 5 and 0.2 at 100 AU

findings_qualitative.value: Gas-phase CH3CN cannot be explained by gas-phase chemistry alone; grain surface chemistry needed

evidence.quote: The observed high abundance of CH$_3$CN gas with respect to HCN therefore implies that grain surface chemistry contributes significantly

claims.hypothesis: MWC 480 disk cyanide composition is comet-like
claims.experiment: Detect lines and fit parametric abundance models, compare ratios to HCN
claims.result: CH3CN and HC3N relative to HCN ~5% at 30 AU and ~20% at 100 AU versus ~10% in comets

evidence.quote: The MWC 480 gas-phase cyanide composition at both 30 and 100 AU is thus cometary within the observational and model uncertainties.

alternatives_considered_or_rejected.value: Inheritance from protostars rejected as sole explanation

evidence.quote: The MWC 480 cyanide composition is thus difficult to explain by inheritance alone

limitations_admitted.value: HC3N/HCN may be overestimated by an order of magnitude; vertical distribution unconstrained

evidence.quote: the HC$_3$N/HCN abundance ratio may be overestimated by an order of magnitude using our simple abundance model

referee_caveats_inferred: CH3CN detections are marginal (5 and 3.5 sigma)
Disk structure fixed rather than fit
Ice ratios rely on generic chemical models not fit to MWC 480
